info.name: Tarcom E-Commerce API
info.description:
Postman collection for the **Tarcom E-Commerce API** (Django REST Framework + SimpleJWT + drf-spectacular), generated from `schema.yml` and the source under `src/tarcom/api/`.

**Setup**
1. `POST /api/auth/signup/` then verify with `POST /api/auth/verify-otp/`.
2. `POST /api/auth/login/` and copy `tokens.access` -> `{{token}}` (and `tokens.refresh` -> `{{refresh_token}}`).
3. Protected requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` automatically (collection-level auth). Public requests are set to *noauth*.
4. Set `{{id}}` / `{{material_id}}` to real record ids before using detail routes.

**Notes**
- All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/` (see `src/tarcom/api/urls.py`).
- Translated resources accept `Accept-Language: en|ar` (fields `*_en`, `*_ar`).
- No pagination is configured - list endpoints return plain JSON arrays.
- Error envelope: `{status, code, message, errors}`.
- Enums: `order.status` PENDING|CONFIRMED|PROCESSING|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED; `payment_status` UNPAID|PAID|REFUNDED; `payment_method` CASH|BANK_TRANSFER|CHECK|CARD; `code_type` SIGNUP|RESET_PASSWORD|FORGET_PASSWORD; `user_type` customer|seller|admin.

request.description:
Creates an unverified account and generates a SIGNUP OTP code.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `201` account created `{message, email}`, `400` validation error (duplicate email, weak password). `user_type` one of `customer`, `seller`, `admin`.

Returns JWT tokens and the user profile for a verified account.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `200` `{tokens: {access, refresh}, user}`, `400` invalid credentials or account not verified. Save `tokens.access` to the `token` collection variable and `tokens.refresh` to `refresh_token`.

POST a `refresh` token to obtain a new `access` token.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `200` `{access, refresh?}`, `400`/`401` invalid or expired refresh token.

Sends an OTP code by email. Rate limited: max 5 codes per email / 15 min.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `200` `{message}`, `400` unknown email / limit reached, `429` throttled.
`code_type`: `SIGNUP` | `RESET_PASSWORD` | `FORGET_PASSWORD`.

Verifies an OTP code. `SIGNUP`: marks the account verified and returns JWT tokens. Password flows: return a signed `reset_token` valid for 10 minutes.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `200` `{message, tokens|user|reset_token}`, `400` invalid or already used code.

Starts password recovery by emailing a `FORGET_PASSWORD` code. Rate limited: max 5 codes per email / 15 min.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `200`, `400`, `429` throttled.

Resets the password accepting an OTP `code` directly instead of the signed `reset_token`.

**Auth:** none (public)
**Responses:** `200` `{message}`, `400` token mismatch / password mismatch.

request.description:
Materials (Products) list endpoint.

**Auth:** public read (anonymous allowed), bearer/staff required to write.
**Responses:** `200` array.

Query params: `category`, `is_active`, `search`, `ordering`, plus spec filters `spec_key1..5` / `spec_val1..5`. A `spec_keyN`/`spec_valN` pair matches materials carrying that key and value on the same slot; either may be used alone to match across all five slots.

Customers see only their own orders; staff/admins see all.

**Auth:** bearer required
**Responses:** `200` array (`order_number`, `status`, `payment_status`, `total_amount`, `items_count`, `created_at`), `401`.

Query: `status`, `payment_status`, `search` (order_number, shipping_phone, user__email), `ordering`.

Places an order. `items` required (>= 1, no duplicate materials); quantity must be > 0 (3 decimals). Totals are calculated server-side from each material's `consumer_price`.

**Responses:** `201` full order detail (status `PENDING`, payment `UNPAID`), `400` validation error, `401`.

Returns the order with nested `items` (material name/image, uom_code, line totals) and user info.

**Responses:** `200`, `401`, `404`.

Routed as `partial_update` on `OrderViewSet`, but the viewset resolves this action to `OrderDetailSerializer`, which declares `read_only_fields = fields`. The endpoint therefore returns `200` with the current order detail and silently ignores any writable payload (e.g. `shipping_address`, `shipping_phone`, `notes`) until a writable order-update serializer is added.

**Responses:** `200` order detail (unchanged), `401`, `404`.

Customers can cancel their own order only while `PENDING`; admins can cancel any time before delivery.

**Responses:** `200` `{message}`, `400` invalid status, `403`, `401`.

Admin only (`IsAdminUser`). Provide at least one of `status` or `payment_status`.

**Responses:** `200` full order detail, `400` none provided, `403`, `401`.
